findings.title: Function exceeds 50 lines and takes 5 parameters
findings.tldr: process_user_submission is 60+ lines and mixes parse/fetch/validate/transform/format in one body.
findings.failure_scenario: Future maintainer adds a 6th step inside this function; cognitive load makes it easy to forget to log the failed parse branch and silently return an error.
findings.good: The 5 sub-sections are labeled with comments, which is the right shape for a 5-function split.
